title: Length of Longest Palindromic Substring
statement:
Given a string S, find the length of its longest palindromic substring.

A substring is a contiguous part of a string. A palindromic substring reads the same forwards and backwards.
constraints:
1 <= |S| <= 1000
S contains only lowercase English letters.
inputFormat: A single line containing the string S.
outputFormat: A single integer: the length of the longest palindromic substring of S.

examples.explanation: 'bab' or 'aba' are both palindromic substrings of length 3.
